_about: A painting for each raid event, shown above its words and choices (RaidEventDefinition > Artwork; Tools/LocalSpawn/generate_ui_art.py events, 1280x720, the Raid style). Keyed by the event's asset name (the Events folder and the rumours' events). The scene the player walks into, no faces needed.
BeaconLight: An old stone beacon hearth on a bare rocky rise above a dark misty pine forest at dusk, stacked high with dry wood, the whole valley spread out below in the mist, a few distant glowing eyes in the trees.
CursedTree: A single dead tree standing in a green forest clearing, the ground around it black and rotten, black veins running up its trunk with a faint sickly purple pulse under the bark, roots stirring out of the soil.
LivingStones: Three tall Norse runestones standing across a forest path in the mist: one green with fresh moss, one glowing faintly warm orange, one scored with deep claw marks, the ground around them freshly churned as if they had moved.
OldBarrow: A low grassy burial mound in a misty forest with a stone-framed doorway half collapsed, a glint of silver in the darkness inside, cold blue mist creeping out of the door.
Oskorei: The Oskorei, a wild ghostly host of riders on black horses galloping through the night sky above a dark pine forest, torches and pale banners streaming, a lone horn rider at the front, storm clouds and moonlight.
ThickeningFog: A ring of old standing stones inside thick white fog in a dark forest, pale floating lights drifting in the fog, an iron-bound chest standing in the middle of the ring.
ThreeWishes: A hooded stranger in a grey cloak standing at a crossroads of three forest paths among tall pines at twilight, face hidden in shadow, an old signpost with three arms beside them.
TollTroll: A huge mossy troll sitting across an old forest road with its chin on its fists, grinning, enormous footprints in the mud before it, mist and tall pines behind.
TradersWagon: A trader's wooden wagon lying on its side on an old forest track, one wheel smashed to splinters, parcels and sacks spilled in the mud, deep claw marks on the boards, misty dark pines around.
TrappedPedlar: A pedlar pinned under a fallen spruce trunk in a dark forest ditch, reaching for his overstuffed pack just out of reach, wolf eyes glowing in the shadows between the trees.
AsasFarmstead: A burned-down Norse farmstead in a dark forest clearing, black charred timbers and a cellar door in the ground, a sturdy straw-blond woman in a linen headscarf sitting on the cellar door with a sack of seed in her lap, refusing to move.
BarrowHoard: Old grave goods half buried under fallen stones inside a dark barrow: silver cups, a rusted helmet and a sword, and among them a pale carved mask that seems to be looking back, cold blue light.
BjarnesForge: A rough forge built from fallen stones and timber in a dark forest clearing, cold coals, a big bearded blacksmith with soot on his face sitting against it with one arm bound to his chest and a hammer across his knees.
BreachSource: A dead tree hung with bones and antlers tied on with cord in a dark misty forest, the ground around it trampled with many creature tracks all leading the same way, an ominous red glow far off.
DeepPatch: A deep forest hollow carpeted with orange cloudberries and golden chanterelle mushrooms growing thick among moss and ferns, a shaft of pale light falling on it through the dark pines.
EiriksStand: A grizzled Norse soldier with a short greying beard standing exhausted in a ring of dead wolves in a dark forest clearing, shield dented, sword still raised, mist around him.
GunnarsPit: A deep well-made pit trap in the forest floor, a weathered hunter in a wolf-fur hood at the bottom of it pinned under a dead boar, sharpened stakes, looking up.
HildsWall: A perfect ring of dry-stone wall, chest high and dead level, standing alone in a misty forest clearing with nothing inside it, a strong-armed woman mason with a headscarf peering over the top.
LivsCircle: A young woman scholar with short dark hair and a blue cloak sitting cross-legged in a ring of glowing runestones in a dark forest, writing in a notebook, the stones humming with pale blue light.
NightCairn: A tall cairn of piled stones higher than a man in a frosty dark clearing at night, rimed with frost, something small and glowing pale blue resting on the very top.
OldBathhouse: A ruined Norse bathhouse in the woods: four log walls and half a turf roof fallen in, a plank door with a drawing of a sauna cut into it, ferns growing through the floor.
RunasMarks: Marks cut into the bark of dark pine trees glowing faintly with moss light at night, leading into the woods, a young red-haired hunter in a green hooded cloak dropping silently from the branches.
SigridsHorn: A Norse woman leader with a dark blond braid and a fur-trimmed cloak leaning on a broken spear in a misty forest at dusk, hurt, a curved horn in her other hand raised to blow.
SilversmithsRest: A weathered wooden bench in a quiet forest glade, a skeleton in a fine fur-trimmed coat sitting on it, a folio wrapped in oilcloth on its lap, moss growing over its boots.
TheElder: The oldest tree imaginable, a vast gnarled elder with roots like walls, and at its foot a single tiny sapling no taller than a hand, glowing faintly green, soft light through the canopy.
TheHeartroot: A colossal split tree stump as wide as a house in a ring of dead trees, the split glowing with amber heart-light deep inside as if breathing, nothing growing around it, mist.
TheLost: A pale lost traveller standing among dark pine trees turning a branch over in their hands, looking up with a blank, hopeful face, mist swirling, faint.
TorsShelter: A neat lean-to shelter of split logs with every joint perfectly square in a dark forest, an old white-bearded carpenter sitting under it with a splinted broken leg, measuring a stick with his thumb.
WainwrightsCamp: An abandoned wainwright's camp in the woods: a half-built wooden wheel on trestles, a cold campfire and an iron-bound chest left behind, tools scattered, fallen leaves.
WildSwarm: A dense dark hanging cluster made of thousands of tiny honey bees, shaped like a sack the size of a man, hanging from a dead branch in a sunlit forest clearing, tiny bees flying around it like specks of gold, wild flowers below. No single large bee.
YrsasFire: An older rosy-cheeked woman with a silver bun stirring a pot over an open cookfire in a dark forest clearing, a wolf-spear across her knees, steam rising, wolves' eyes glowing at the edge of the light.
RotsHeart: A huge knot of black rotten wood half sunk in the forest floor like a heart, beating with a sickly purple glow, black veins of blight running out from it through the moss to the trees all around, a dark misty forest.
